title: Alpha Hypixel Network
wikitext:
{{/Status}}{{ClockWidget|mode=alpha}} [[File:AlphaHypixelNetwork.png|thumb|Image for the Alpha Hypixel Network used in the introduction announcement.]] [[File:AlphaHypixelNetworkServer.png|thumb|The server as seen in the Minecraft Multiplayer tab.]] The '''Alpha Hypixel Network''' (acronymized as '''AHN'''), or '''Alpha Network''', is a testing server that allows players to test upcoming updates for games on the Hypixel Network. This server is on {{Code|alpha.hypixel.net}}. The Alpha Hypixel Network hosts testing sessions in which the server is open players to test specified subjects, usually upcoming updates or features for specific games. Currently, [[SkyBlock]] is the only supported game on the server, and upcoming updates for the game are planned to be tested in the server. A rank requirement may be present for joining the Alpha Network. == Mechanic == [[File:Alpha Server Noticeboard.png|thumb|The Server Noticeboard on the Alpha Network Game Lobby]] A '''Server Noticeboard''' was added to the Alpha Network on 22 November 2022, with information about the session objective. The '''Alpha Network Game Lobby''' was added on 6 December 2022, replacing the Hypixel Game Lobby, a map from the main server. === Alpha Network Reset === When an '''Alpha Network Reset''' (or '''Network Reset''') happens: * Any previous progress on the Alpha Network is wiped. * Upon joining SkyBlock, a player will enter the profile they last played on the main server. Upon joining the first profile after a reset, a '''Transfer of Progress''' ''may'' happen: * All progress made by the player on all profiles on the main server will be transferred the Alpha Network, including all built structures on the private island of each profile. * Player begins receiving game messages about [[achievements]]/[[collections]] unlocks, and [[skills]]/[[pet]] leveling up, until they are the same as on its corresponding profile on the main server. * Note: The above is the ''intended'' behavior. It ''can'' happen that a player joins the Alpha Network without a proper transfer of progress. That is, they start as if they play SkyBlock for the first time. Upon joining the first profile after a reset, this message appears: {{Rmt|&eWelcome to &aHypixel SkyBlock &eon the Alpha Network! &a&lALPHA! &ePlease report bugs at &nhttps://hypixel.net/bugs}} === Time on Alpha Network === Before 21 August 2022, the [[SkyBlock Time]] on Alpha Network was the same as that of the main server. On 21 August 2022, the SkyBlock Time on Alpha Network was shifted by exactly {{Green|211,680 seconds / 58 hours and 48 minutes}} in Earth's duration or {{Green|176.4 days / 5 months, 21 days, 9 hours and 36 minutes}} in SkyBlock's duration ahead of the main server. This change was persistent to future sessions. On 9 April 2024, the Alpha server had a different time offset from what it previously had, presumably because the content being tested was only available during the first quarter of each SkyBlock year (spring). It was modified to be exactly 210 SkyBlock days (70 hours) ahead of the regular server, and the server was opened to the public around the start of Early Spring 2, Year 343. The time offset was later changed on an unknown date (June 10, 2024 at the latest) to match the main server exactly. === General Points to Note === * Progress made after the Transfer of Progress is branched out from the main server, and later progress on either alpha or main server will not affect the other. * New features or new testing sessions on the Alpha Network do not necessarily come with a Network Reset; It is on admin's decision to trigger a Network Reset. * The '''player limit''' of during each session, shown on server listings, can change on admin's decision. This limits the number of players that can play the Alpha Network at the same time. * The [[Auction House]] generally does not work on the alpha server == Observed Behavior == The observed similarities and differences of the Alpha Network with the main server is listed below. === Events === All [[events]] seem to also happen on the Alpha Hypixel Network. For example: * Every [[Jacob's Farming Contest]]s are scheduled at the same time with the same crops as the main server. * During [[Traveling Zoo]], {{NPCSprite|Oringo}} has the same [[Traveling Zoo/Stock|pet stocks]] as the main server. * [[Bingo]] events run at the same time and with the same tasks as the main server. * [[Mayor Election]]s run separately from those on the main server, but special mayors appear in the same years as on the main server. See [[Mayor Election#On the Alpha Hypixel Network]]. === Others === * {{NPCSprite|Centauri}} is an [[NPC]] that grants {{c}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, item upgrades and update-featured items. Can also be accessed with the {{Code|/centauri}} [[Commands|command]]. * The {{Item|Chocolate Factory}} has a button that gives {{Chocolate|1b}} for testing. * {{NPCSprite|Salesman}} does not appear in the [[Hub]]. * {{NPCSprite|Simon}} appeared in the [[Hub]] in Year 200 handing out [[Century Cake]]s. * {{NPCSprite|Hub Selector}} lists only 12 servers, instead of 28 as in the main server. * {{NPCSprite|Dungeon Hub Selector}} lists only 3 servers, instead of 28 as in the main server. * In a given year where {{NPCSprite|Candidate Jerry}} is mayor, the [[Perkpocalypse]] Mayor Rotation Cycle is the same as in the main server. * Players cannot bid on [[Shen's Auction]] or {{zone|Regalia Room}} auctions. Changes on the main server may not be reflected on the Alpha Network immediately: * When {{NPCSprite|Simon}} was removed on the main server on 11 April 2022, he was not removed at the same time on the Alpha Network. When the {{NPCSprite|Security Sloth}} was added to the main server on 24 May 2022, it was not added immediately on the Alpha Network. Instead, both changes were done when a session opened on 9 June 2022. * When the main server [[Hub]] was Easter-decorated in 2022, the Alpha Network Hub was not changed. == Sessions == {{Transclude|Alpha Hypixel Network/Sessions}} == Trivia == * The server was announced on May 5th, 2020, along with the return of linking to the [https://hypixel.net/discord Hypixel Discord] through the {{Code|/discord}} [[Commands|Command]], and access to the #admin-lounge channel for testers.https://hypixel.net/threads/2853652/ * When attempting to use {{Code|/skyblock}} after a Network Reset, if the player was on a {{Gamemode|stranded}} [[profile]] when joining, this message can appear:
{{Rmt|&cYou were kicked while joining that server!}}
{{Rmt|&cCannot join that island on a Stranded profile!}}
Clicking on the SkyBlock Lobby NPC does not trigger this warning and player is able to enter SkyBlock normally. * When the player is awarded Bingo Points from previous [[Bingo]] events, this message can appear:
{{Rmt|&eYou have been given [#] Bingo Points that were missing from the [n-th] Bingo.}} * Currently and before 26 July 2022, when attempting to join the server when it is closed or when rank is insufficient, the connection screen will show:
{{Rmt|&7Failed to connect to the server &cThe Hypixel Alpha server is currently closed!}} * In the time between 26 July 2022 and Early 2023, When rank is insufficient (current), the player will still be able to join the Lobby in Alpha Network, but this message shows when attempting to enter SkyBlock:
{{Rmt|&cYou were kicked while joining that server! &cCan't find your SkyBlock info! Try &b\/play skyblock!}} * When a player is idle for too long, the server will attempt to send them to the Prototype Lobby, which has a capacity of 0 player on the Alpha Network. The following messages will appear:
{{Rmt|&eYou are being transferred to the &aPrototype Lobby &efor being &cAFK&e! &cThat lobby is currently full! Try again later.}} * Trying to join without having played skyblock will result in the following message:
{{Rmt|&cFailed cloning your SkyBlock data: Your SkyBlock data was not migrated yet. Please join SkyBlock on mc.hypixel.net first!}} * Buying a rank while connected to the Alpha server will not provide the rank until the main server is joined again. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2020/March 12|link=none|The Alpha Hypixel Network increased the player limit from 200 to 400 players.}} {{history|2020/May 5|link=none|The Alpha Hypixel Network was announced with the beginning of the first testing session.}} {{history|Unknown; August 2020|{{Code|alpha.hypixel.net}} is redirected to the main Hypixel server.}} {{history|Unknown; June 2021|{{Code|alpha.hypixel.net}} is connected to the Alpha Hypixel Network, no longer being redirected.}} {{history|2022/August 21|link=none|SkyBlock Time on the Alpha Network was shifted by 176.4 SkyBlock Days ahead.}} {{history|2022/November 22|'''Server Noticeboard''' was added.}} {{history|2022/December 6|link=none|'''Alpha Network Game Lobby''' was added, replacing the Hypixel Game Lobby.}} }} == References ==
